A1.justification: Both PDFs describe SJD-PAC and contain readable main text, figures, tables, equations and Appendices A–B. All 13 pages were compared; pages 2–13 are textually and visually identical.

before.justification: v1 reports original SJD-PAC speed and image-quality evaluations, component ablations and hyperparameter analyses in Section 5, plus memory and latency measurements in Appendix B.

after.justification: v2 retains the original SJD-PAC evaluations, ablations and supplementary overhead measurements reported in v1.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Algorithm 1 are identical, retaining the same Proactive Drafting and Adaptive Continuation procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate text-to-image generation on MS-COCO 2017 and PartiPrompts and retain the image-versus-text perturbation study in Section 4.2. No dataset, task or test scenario changes.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains identical comparator membership on both benchmarks: EAGLE, described as EAGLE-2 in Section 5.1, SJD, LANTERN++, GSD and SJD2 for Lumina-mGPT; SJD and SJD2 for Emu3. The qualitative GSD comparison is also unchanged.

E3.justification: The models, resolutions, sampling settings, dataset splits, metrics and evaluation procedures are unchanged. Both versions specify K=4, D=3 and L=64 for SJD-PAC and retain identical ablation and overhead settings.

E4.justification: The acceptance-length and perturbation analyses, PD/AC ablations, window-length and tree-hyperparameter studies, qualitative examples and Appendix B overhead analysis are identical.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative examples in Tables 1–4 and Figures 1–6 are unchanged. For example, both report 4.51× step compression and 3.80× wall-clock speedup for SJD-PAC on Lumina-mGPT with MS-COCO.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and reasoning in Sections 3–4 and the correctness theorems, derivations and proofs in Appendix A are identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about training-free, lossless acceleration using PD and AC. The added code-access sentence does not alter the scientific contributions or performance claims.

C2.justification: Explanations involving image-token locality, sequence stability and computational tradeoffs are unchanged. Section 6 retains the same qualification about dependence on K, D and L and the same future-work discussion.

D1.justification: v2 adds a sentence to the abstract stating that code is available at the GitHub repository KangJialiang/SJD-PAC; v1 provides no such address. Implementation settings and supplementary technical details are unchanged. The PDFs alone do not establish the repository's contents or usability.

R1.justification: The same 31 references and related-work discussion are retained, with unchanged positioning relative to speculative decoding, SJD and lossy acceleration methods.

P1.justification: v2 appends one code-availability sentence to the abstract and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. All other prose, terminology and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: The additional abstract line produces a small first-page spacing and introduction-position adjustment, alongside the updated margin stamp. Figures, tables, captions and the layout of pages 2–13 are identical.

improvement.justification: The repository address added to v2's abstract improves implementation discoverability and code-access documentation. This is a limited improvement: the scientific content, evidence and appendices are unchanged, and the PDFs do not establish whether the referenced code is complete or usable.
